Triage: lands in `domain:spec` (`translation.zod.ts`, with a ui reader) · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux (i18n) · Bug · the new `relatedLists[].label` has no translation key, so a declared record-page tab title cannot be localised and shows in its authored language for every user. Found at PR #36527 (card #35902, topic #35896) → p2 as the seat suggested · size S. On request from repo:objectstack#2 (#32588 comment 7083095560).

Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-22T22:30Z · card thread of seat `repo:objectstack#2`, reporting to area s2-A (record page and forms); the maintainer gave area:ux p1/p2 topic children to this seat (2026-11-22), and #36528 is a child of topic #35896

Branch: `claude/project-thread-qwdwll`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-36528`
Domain: `domain:spec`
Seat: `repo:objectstack#2`
File surface: `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` (the new key), `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` (the overlay on the served parent object), the translation tooling that reads every sibling `_`-group key: `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts` (extract/coverage walk), `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts` (orphan-key rule), `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-translated-echo.ts` only if a translated served label could be saved back as source; the ui reader only if the console reads `relatedLists[].label` from an untranslated face; spec generated artefacts regenerated (never hand-edited), docs pages that list the object translation groups, tests, `.changeset/`. No `skills/**`, no `docs/adr/**`. (Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:thread` (this card thread; one `os-dev` subagent in its container), `model: default (dispatch-gates --tier at 87c7bbaf: "no path-derived mandate")`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Responsibility: the risk is in objectstack's own spec: `ObjectTranslationDataSchema` (strict) has no key for a `relatedLists[]` object entry's `label`, so a bundle cannot carry it and a translator who invents one is refused | no platform path covers it: the child FK's `relatedListTitle` is translatable, but the entry's `label` wins over it, and the entry exists so a parent's author need not edit the child | reached by any app author who titles a tab in an object's `relatedLists` (added by #35902 under the maintainer's topic #35896); zero in-repo authors today (`grep -rn relatedLists examples packages/platform-objects/src` = 0 non-test hits)
Thread-read: 7083103288
Premise: holds — on `main` 87c7bbaf, `grep -n -i relatedList packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` hits only the field-level `relatedListTitle` lines (249–263); `RelatedListEntryObjectSchema.label` is `z.string().min(1).optional()` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`); `i18n-resolver.ts` has no `relatedLists` reader. The dev re-measures before writing.
New key name (seat's call, by precedent): `objects.<object>._relatedLists.<list>.label`, on the PARENT object (where the entry is declared), keyed by the entry's literal `list` value, a dotted `object.field` included and indexed directly, never split. Precedents: `_tabs.<tab_name>.label` (#5377, object-scoped tab title keyed by its name); the `_views` / `_actions` / `_validations` groups (the authoring key with the `_` prefix, plus the un-prefixed alias `relatedLists`); `resultDialog.fields` (literal keys that may contain dots, indexed directly).
Pre-claim lane: `domain:spec` — the key lands in `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`; its readers in `packages/lint` and `packages/metadata-protocol` stay in this card under the lane-keep rule (fix route clear, one PR).
Pre-claim deps: the card names no `Blocked-by:`. Its source PR #36527 (card #35902) is the producer of `relatedLists[].label` on `main`.
Prior rulings read: `check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 36528 --terms relatedLists,relatedListTitle,_tabs,translation` at 87c7bbaf → ADR-0129 D3, ADR-0156 D3 (term `translation` only; neither rules on this key; the overlay is per-caller, which ADR-0156 D3 already keeps outside the cached part); thread: none. ADR-0146 D10 (the `.custom` arrangement, PR #36517) read for the serial constraint below.
Serial constraints cleared: #36517 (this seat, `pm:awaiting-merge`) edits `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts` and adds `ObjectExtensionSchema.relatedLists` entries that carry `label`: if it lands first, this PR merges main and covers labels a `.custom` arrangement brings; if this PR lands first, the gap is named for #36517's lander. #36543 (this seat, rework) edits `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` and `authoring-rules.ts`. `overlap-check.mjs` runs before every push; a textual overlap queues this PR behind the named one.
